what: When the artwork (birds·hand-drawn ornaments) touches the 60% line of the screen, once — it settles from 6rem to the right at .8 scale, pivoting on the bottom right, in 1.2s easeOutCubic, while a mask spreading from top to bottom (mask-size 100% 0 → 300%, transparent→crisp during the first 30%) clears over 5s so the artwork is revealed from the top

options.--fx-x: Distance sliding in from the right (set via style), default 6rem
options.--fx-mask: Length of time for the cover to clear (via style), default 5s

note: The original mask is an image that is opaque at the top and transparent at the bottom (mask-obj.png) — here a gradient that cuts from 30%→34% gives the same spread from the top. The mask reads only opacity, so the color variable can be any opaque color

from.where: index.html .ky-hato (.ky-intro__hato · .ky-op__hato) — original c-effect-hato: translate(6rem) scale(.8) origin right bottom · transform 1.2s easeOutCubic · maskMove 5s easeOutCubic · start top 60%
